label: schema
sql: CREATE SCHEMA client_dev.ashlar_burst_20261005_k1 COMMENT 'Ashlar synthetic scheduled publication stream'

label: ddl-object_current
sql:
CREATE TABLE client_dev.ashlar_burst_20261005_k1.object_current (
  source_system STRING NOT NULL, type_id BIGINT NOT NULL, id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  logical_key_json STRING NOT NULL, schema_revision STRING NOT NULL,
  entity_version BIGINT NOT NULL, props_json STRING NOT NULL,
  retained_json STRING NOT NULL, root_id BIGINT,
  source_feed STRING NOT NULL, source_epoch STRING NOT NULL,
  source_position BIGINT NOT NULL, published_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
) USING DELTA CLUSTER BY (source_system, type_id, id)
TBLPROPERTIES ('delta.dataSkippingStatsColumns'='source_system,type_id,id','delta.feature.catalogManaged'='supported','delta.targetFileSize'='16777216');

label: ddl-property_journal
sql:
CREATE TABLE client_dev.ashlar_burst_20261005_k1.property_journal (
  source_system STRING NOT NULL, entity_kind STRING NOT NULL,
  type_id BIGINT NOT NULL, id BIGINT NOT NULL, property_id BIGINT,
  entity_version BIGINT NOT NULL, operation STRING NOT NULL,
  old_present BOOLEAN NOT NULL, old_json STRING,
  new_present BOOLEAN NOT NULL, new_json STRING,
  schema_revision STRING NOT NULL, source_feed STRING NOT NULL,
  source_epoch STRING NOT NULL, source_position BIGINT NOT NULL,
  event_ordinal BIGINT NOT NULL, source_time_text STRING,
  published_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
) USING DELTA CLUSTER BY (source_feed, source_position, id)
TBLPROPERTIES ('delta.dataSkippingStatsColumns'='source_feed,source_epoch,source_position,id','delta.feature.catalogManaged'='supported','delta.targetFileSize'='134217728');

hydrate-parity-1
sql: SELECT count(*),count_if(o.props_json IS DISTINCT FROM s.new_props OR o.retained_json IS DISTINCT FROM s.retained_json OR get_json_object(o.props_json,'$.101') IS DISTINCT FROM get_json_object(s.new_props,'$.101') OR cast(get_json_object(o.props_json,'$.102') AS BIGINT) IS DISTINCT FROM cast(get_json_object(s.new_props,'$.102') AS BIGINT) OR o.entity_version<>1 OR o.source_position<>1 OR o.source_system<>'pilot' OR o.type_id<>1 OR o.logical_key_json<>to_json(array(o.id)) OR o.schema_revision<>'r1' OR o.source_feed<>'S' OR o.source_epoch<>'e') FROM client_dev.ashlar_burst_20261005_k1.object_current VERSION AS OF 2 o JOIN client_dev.ashlar_burst_20261005_k1.stage_1 s ON s.id=o.id

columns.name: count_if((((((NOT (props_json <=> new_props)) OR (NOT (retained_json <=> retained_json))) OR (NOT (get_json_object(props_json, $.101) <=> get_json_object(new_props, $.101)))) OR (((NOT (CAST(get_json_object(props_json, $.102) AS BIGINT) <=> CAST(get_json_object(new_props, $.102) AS BIGINT))) OR (NOT (entity_version = 1))) OR (NOT (source_position = 1)))) OR ((((NOT (source_system = pilot)) OR (NOT (type_id = 1))) OR (NOT (logical_key_json = to_json(array(id))))) OR (((NOT (schema_revision = r1)) OR (NOT (source_feed = S))) OR (NOT (source_epoch = e))))))
